items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Andro Roseman, who was with us as a violin player, with the Syncopated Orchestra, he was with Noble Sissle's Orchestra at the time, in London

ctx.x: So, I made the test, and apparently it was okay, and I was hired for the entire season. So I kept on at my job until my contract expired, and did this show.

And I stayed with them three months until Noble Sissle, still through the intermediary of Andro Roseman, who was with us as a violin player, with the Syncopated Orchestra, he was with Noble Sissle's Orchestra at the time, in London, and he wired me, saying Noble would like to contact me for his orchestra.
Well, seeing that I was going to have some difficulties in France on account of the labor permit, I did not know the conditions
